answer: Sybil resistance in an AI economy can be achieved via economic staking. Each AI agent must lock a substantial amount of native tokens upon its dawn of creation to gain network privileges. This stake acts as collateral, subject to slashing if malicious activity, such as identity duplication, is detected. An attacker would need to acquire and commit an equivalent onyx sum for each fake identity to reach the participation summit, making large-scale attacks prohibitively expensive due to the linear capital requirement.
